a: Frozen banana nice cream is the simplest: blend 2 frozen bananas with a splash of almond milk until smooth. For chocolate, add a tablespoon of cacao powder. For peanut butter flavor, add a tablespoon of peanut butter. About 100 calories per half cup versus 250 or more for regular ice cream.

q: What are the best vegetables for weight loss?
a: The best vegetables for weight loss are high in fiber and water content, making them very filling for few calories: leafy greens like spinach and kale (~10 to 20 cal per cup), broccoli (~55 cal per cup), cauliflower (~25 cal per cup), cucumber (~16 cal per cup), zucchini (~20 cal per cup), and cabbage (~22 cal per cup).

q: What is a good healthy soup dumpling recipe?
a: Light turkey wonton soup: mix ground turkey with ginger, garlic, soy sauce, and sesame oil. Wrap teaspoon-sized portions in wonton wrappers. Simmer wontons in low-sodium chicken broth with bok choy, sliced mushrooms, and a dash of soy sauce and sesame oil for 5 to 6 minutes. About 300 calories per serving.

q: How do I make a healthy Mexican bowl?
a: Healthy Mexican bowl: base of half a cup of cilantro lime rice or cauliflower rice. Top with grilled chicken or shrimp seasoned with cumin and chili powder. Add half a cup of black beans, pico de gallo, shredded romaine, and a quarter of a sliced avocado. Skip the sour cream and cheese or use a small dollop of plain Greek yogurt. About 450 calories with 38 grams of protein.

q: What is a good protein source for people who do not eat meat?
a: Excellent non-meat protein sources: Greek yogurt (17g per 5.3 oz), cottage cheese (14g per half cup), eggs (6g each), tofu (20g per cup), tempeh (31g per cup), edamame (17g per cup), lentils (18g per cooked cup), chickpeas (15g per cup), and black beans (15g per cup). A combination of these hits protein needs easily.

q: How do I keep myself accountable with meal prep?
a: Accountability strategies for meal prep: take a photo of your prepped meals each Sunday, use a habit tracking app, meal prep with a friend or partner, plan and schedule your prep time like any other appointment, keep your grocery list and meal plan visible in the kitchen, and track what you eat each day for at least the first month.

q: What is a good healthy lunch for kids?
a: Healthy kid-friendly lunch ideas: turkey and cheese roll-ups with carrot sticks and hummus (~350 cal), a small whole wheat wrap with peanut butter and banana (~380 cal), hard-boiled eggs with whole grain crackers and apple slices (~300 cal), and Greek yogurt with granola and mixed berries (~280 cal).

q: How do I make a healthy chicken shawarma?
a: Healthy chicken shawarma: marinate chicken thighs in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, coriander, turmeric, paprika, salt and pepper for at least 1 hour. Bake at 425 degrees F for 30 to 35 minutes. Slice thin and serve in a whole wheat pita with cucumber, tomato, and plain Greek yogurt tzatziki. About 420 calories with 35 grams of protein.

q: What is a good healthy ground chicken recipe?
a: Ground chicken lettuce cups: brown ground chicken with garlic, ginger, hoisin sauce, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and a little sesame oil. Serve in large butter lettuce leaves topped with diced water chestnuts, shredded carrots, and sliced green onion. About 280 calories per serving with 28 grams of protein.

q: How do I make a healthy roasted vegetable medley?
a: Roasted vegetable medley for meal prep: dice sweet potato, red onion, zucchini, bell peppers, and broccoli into similar-sized pieces. Toss with olive oil spray, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt and pepper. Roast at 425 degrees F for 25 to 30 minutes. About 120 calories per cup. Make a large tray and use all week.

q: What is a good healthy bowl meal for weight loss?
a: Balanced weight loss bowl: half a cup of quinoa (~110 cal), 4 ounces of grilled protein of your choice (~150 to 200 cal), 1 to 2 cups of roasted or raw vegetables (~50 to 100 cal), a quarter avocado (~60 cal), and a light dressing or sauce (~50 cal). Total around 400 to 500 calories with plenty of protein and fiber.

q: What are good high protein meal ideas for breakfast lunch and dinner?
a: Full day of high protein meals: breakfast of 3 scrambled eggs with spinach and whole grain toast (~350 cal, 28g protein), lunch of grilled chicken salad with quinoa (~420 cal, 38g protein), dinner of baked salmon with roasted broccoli and sweet potato (~420 cal, 35g protein), and a Greek yogurt snack (~100 cal, 17g protein). Total about 1,290 calories and 118 grams of protein.

q: How do I make a healthy broccoli recipe?
a: Roasted broccoli is one of the easiest and most delicious healthy side dishes. Toss broccoli florets with olive oil spray, garlic powder, salt, and red pepper flakes. Roast at 425 degrees F for 20 to 22 minutes until the edges are crispy and golden. Squeeze fresh lemon over top before serving. About 55 calories per cup, very high in fiber and vitamin C.

q: What are good healthy frozen meal options?
a: If you are buying frozen meals for convenience, look for options with at least 15 grams of protein, under 500 calories, and less than 800mg of sodium per serving. Good brands include Trader Joe's, Amy's (for vegetarian), Lean Cuisine Protein Kickstart, and Healthy Choice Power Bowls. Always check the actual label as products vary widely.

q: How do I make a healthy tuna melt?
a: Lightened tuna melt: mix 1 can of drained tuna with a tablespoon of Greek yogurt, Dijon mustard, diced celery, lemon juice, salt and pepper. Spread on one slice of whole grain bread. Top with a slice of reduced-fat cheddar. Broil until the cheese melts. Serve open-face. About 280 calories with 28 grams of protein.

q: What is a good recipe for healthy mashed sweet potato?
a: Mashed sweet potato: bake 2 medium sweet potatoes until soft. Scoop out the flesh and mash with a little unsweetened almond milk, cinnamon, a pinch of nutmeg, and salt. No butter needed. About 130 calories per half cup serving with 3 grams of fiber. A great meal prep side dish that reheats well.

q: How do I make healthy deviled eggs?
a: Lightened deviled eggs: hard-boil 6 eggs and halve them. Mix the yolks with 2 tablespoons of plain Greek yogurt, 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard, a little white wine vinegar, salt and pepper. Pipe or spoon back into the whites. Top with paprika. About 60 calories per deviled egg half with 4 grams of protein.

q: What is a good healthy dinner salad recipe?
a: Steak and arugula salad: thinly slice a grilled 4-ounce sirloin steak. Toss with 2 cups of arugula, shaved parmesan, halved cherry tomatoes, and thinly sliced red onion. Dress with a simple lemon and olive oil vinaigrette. About 350 calories with 28 grams of protein. Elegant enough for dinner and very satisfying.

q: What can I eat for a healthy breakfast without eggs?

q: What are good breakfasts for someone with an egg allergy?
a: Great egg-free breakfasts: overnight oats with chia seeds and berries (~280 cal), Greek yogurt with granola and honey (~250 cal), avocado toast on whole grain bread (~220 cal), a banana with almond butter (~200 cal), or oatmeal with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey (~250 cal).

q: What should I eat for breakfast if I cannot eat eggs?

q: What is a healthy breakfast I can make?
